Ana (PM): ByteCloud requires route-level cost visibility + trace hooks. they asked for a launch commitment in next week's customer sync. can we agree MVP by Friday?
Kevin (Eng): Quick take: route cost via hourly rollups + SDK trace interceptors. Per-request billing parity is out for MVP. Risks: span ingestion lag and added CPU for sampling.
Ella (CS): Customer needs: top routes by est $/hr, route -> recent traces (error filter), filter by model and time window.
Maria (SRE): Ops constraints: default sampling 10%, force-sample errors for 48h. Gate rollout on span-ingest lag <30s p90 and set span quota.
Sam (Design): UI: left cost leaderboard (sparkline + est $/hr), right route details with trace filters and a "why this cost" flyout. will post mock by EOD.
Kevin (Eng): Rough dev split: metrics UI 2w, SDK+ingestion 2w, canary+rollout 1w. Metrics names: `redwood.route.tokens.hourly_total`, `redwood.route.estimated_usd.hourly`. Trace attrs: `route_id`, `model_name`.
telemetry-bot: dashboard template created id=dg-99901 link=https://console.redwood/internal/dash/dg-99901
Ana (PM): MVP acceptance criteria draft:
- Console lists top 20 routes by estimated USD & token count for chosen window.
- Route detail shows sampled traces, filters for error & p95 latency, and links to model/quant profile.
- Costs labeled "estimated" with tooltip describing hourly-rollup method.
- SDK interceptors for Node/Python (gRPC & HTTP). default sample=10%; errors force-sampled for 48h.
- Perf: combined change adds <5ms to P95 generation latency in staging.
- Rollout: FF canary to 5% with auto-fallback to metrics-only if sampling lag >2m.
Maria (SRE): Also abort canary if span storage burn or ingestion lag exceeds thresholds. schedule staging smoke test (50k rps spike).
Ella (CS): i'll draft FAQ clarifying Console estimates are not invoice-accurate.
Sam (Design): small add: CSV export for top routes for finance.
Kevin (Eng): snippet:
```
span.setAttribute('route_id', route.id)
span.setAttribute('model_name', model.name)
```
Add env override `REDWOOD_TRACE_SAMPLING`.
Ana (PM): Decision checklist by Friday:
1) thumbs on MVP criteria
2) Sam posts mock
3) Kevin files epic + canary plan
4) Ella drafts FAQ
5) Maria schedules smoke test
React with :thumbsup: or flag blockers.
